pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. One complete adult person sitting at small table with an unfinished flower drawing, holding a pencil with broken graphite tip, extending open free hand toward a sharp whole pencil lying on other side of table. A red pointer arrow identifies needed sharp pencil. Flat solid fills dark outlines, whole person furniture, no text. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
